title: Vigilante
summary: Vigilante is an assassin-like Draco-Titan whose face and body are covered by a flowing cloak. Vigilante once belonged to an evil Seeker, would therefore only bond to someone with a strong dark side, and that is why, after his Amulet came into the possession of the Huntik Foundation, Vigilante became the primary Titan of the orphan, Den Fears.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Metz believed that Vigilante was originally used by a very evil Seeker and thus would easily bond to a Seeker with a strong dark side. [Den vs Harrison]

Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill were tasked to deliver Vigilante's Amulet to Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ. However they were intercepted by the Blood Spiral and Lok ended up dropping the Amulet during a battle on the Erasmus Bridge. Den Fears then fought Harrison Fears for the Amulet, and the Titan sensed and ended up bonding with Den to become his first and primary Titan. Vigilante then fought against Harlekin, but with Den choked and beaten by Harrison and unable to concentrate, Vigilante was sent back to his Amulet. [Den vs Harrison]

Den used Vigilante during the Huntik team's attempt to rescue Focauld Casterwill from Kiel and Marduk in the Cloisters. He was, however, defeated by Marduk's Cerberus. [The Casterwill Connection]

In Hamelin, Den invoked Vigilante to help Sophie Casterwill against two Suits. Charged up with a power boost from Cherit, Vigilante fought and defeated Shadow Agent. [Gremlow Infestation!]

Den attempted to invoke Vigilante against Wilder in the Professor's castle but Wilder kicked the Amulet out of his hand. [An Ally from the Organization]

At the Blood Spiral Base, after faltering during his final battle with his brother, Harrison, Den sensed Vigilante becoming Powerbonded, reminding him that him not to let his friends down. After invoking Powerbonded Vigilante, Den merged with him using his new Cindercloak ability and fought and defeated Powerbonded Antedeluvian. Before he could defeat Harrison however, Vigilante was disrupted by falling rocks and sent back to his Amulet. [Lok and the Betrayer]

Den invoked Powerbonded Vigilante in Japan where he fought alongside Powerbonded Baselaird to defeat two Shadow Agent Titans when they arrived at Emi's house. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Powerbonding
sections.text:
Vigilante became Powerbonded with Den during his final battle with his brother, Harrison. Using his new Cindercloak ability, Den was able to merge with Vigilante in a similar fashion to how Lok Lambert merges with Powerbonded Kipperin. Powerbonded Vigilante can then separate himself from his Seeker in order to provide protection, such as when he used this ability to protect Den when the ruins of the Spiral Mark started to collapse. Together, Den and Vigilante's sword strikes are powerful enough to defeat Powerbonded Antedeluvian.[Lok and the Betrayer] Powerbonded Vigilante's other new abilities include:

• Counterattack - swiftly strikes an enemy after defending their attack. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]
• Cross defense - crosses his two swords to block an attack. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Vigilante's summoning command is '''"Even the odds, Vigilante!'''"

*The word vigilante is derived from the Spanish word for "watchman" and refers to one who enacts law enforcement without the legal authority. Vigilantes were prominent in European and American history during the absence of official law enforcement or a protective military force.
